definitions.explanation: A work of writing, especially a book or scholarly publication. Refers to the finished product.
The act of writing and publishing written works. Often used in compounds related to intellectual property and copyright.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{著作|ちょさく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This work has been translated around the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{著作|ちょさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{借|か}りて→借りる：00532_kariru⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{役立|やくだ}てた→役立てる：12550_yakudateru⟧。
examples.english: I borrowed a famous scholar's work from the library and used it for my research.

examples.japanese: ⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}→著作権：14022_chosakuken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{侵害|しんがい}→侵害：11563_shingai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not infringe on copyright.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}→著作権：14022_chosakuken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{撮影者|さつえいしゃ}→撮影者：26286_satsueisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The copyright for this photograph belongs to the photographer.

examples.japanese: {著作|ちょさく}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{教|おし}えている→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: While continuing to write, he also teaches at a university.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}→著作権：14022_chosakuken⟧ (copyright). As a standalone word, it refers to a published work, particularly non-fiction or scholarly writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}→著作権：14022_chosakuken⟧ (copyright)
- ⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}{侵害|しんがい}→著作権侵害：25454_chosakukenshingai⟧ (copyright infringement)
- {著作|ちょさく}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (writing activities)
- ⟦{著作物|ちょさくぶつ}→著作物：18133_chosakubutsu⟧ (copyrighted work; authored material)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: work — broader term covering any creative work including art, music, and film
- ⟦{著書|ちょしょ}→著書：14083_chosho⟧: book by an author — specifically refers to books, not other types of writing
